name: Clipboard History
description: Everything you copied as text, found again in one click — local, searchable, pinnable

pollSeconds.description: Seconds between clipboard reads on a system without change notifications; 0.5 is the smallest value

maxChars.description: Texts longer than this many characters are not recorded

maxEntries.description: How many unpinned entries are kept; pinned entries do not count

paused.description: Stop recording, for example while using a password manager; the flyout toggles this too
